scripts.dev: npm run build -w @izbri/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @izbri/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @izbri/contracts && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
